title: [P0-P7 blocker ledger] HIA production qualification — exact source, safety, ABI, migration, value, Agent and recovery
body:
# HIA P0–P7 — production blockers (fail-closed)

**Status:** `OPEN` / `DENY_ALL`. This issue tracks the user's requested complete HIA P0–P7 closure. It is **not** a new release grant. A green unit or scoped workflow never closes unrelated gates.

## Frozen observed integration basis (2026-10-31)

- `main`: `125d11c5454835a7df1dc51915fc49901fbede5b` (not a production HIA integration).
- Integrated research source: [#467](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Hepta/pull/467), exact `11e4ccfedf273de1d47fe9910c776591ed466626`; P0/P1/P2/P3/P5 finite scopes, strict native host and JSON gates.
- P0 verification provenance hardening: [#469](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Hepta/pull/469) at `12d8ca6e4c30ae1781de899c563b1543c9aaf315`; 11/109/13 tests passed in [run 41187228127](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Hepta/actions/runs/41187228127), but broad native workflows remain separate evidence.
- P7 source-owned queue item snapshot: [#470](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Hepta/pull/470) at `8d7c297d123b50b9156cacbc19a5cec77c14f8c0`; exact-head scoped/host CI outcome must be read before qualifying the repair.
- Original Hepta main [blockers](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Hepta/blob/main/docs/BLOCKERS.md), [#418](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Hepta/pull/418), [#434](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Hepta/pull/434), [#455–#460](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Hepta/pull/460). Hepta-native NDU bridge and original negative standalone-cost readout: [hepta-private-ci #4118](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/pull/4118).

## Strict closure checklist (all must pass on the same *final* integrated source)

- [ ] **P0 unified semantics.** Exactly one versioned HIA/Core opcode source; explicit HSIR legacy adapter/no inferred v0 collision; immutable bounded input; compiler/checker/VM/Rust independent verifier/LLVM route consistency; proof of finite scoped refinement (or explicit unproved boundary); independently reviewed exact-head source, test and native artifacts. No skipped/expected-failure tests or source/workspace drift.
- [ ] **P1 safety/resource semantics.** Typed owner, loan, lifetime, provenance, effects/capabilities, exception/trap, normal/error-value/abort/cancel/forced-exit, cross-module and foreign-call contracts; independently checked correct and rejecting cases; native stack/RSS and allocation/FFI budgets stated explicitly. No whole-language claim from scoped symbolic tests.
- [ ] **P2 machine code, ABI, hardware.** x86-64, AArch64, Windows, macOS real-host C/Hepta bidirectional ABI probes with GCC/Clang/MSVC; native artifact + exact target identity; reject unsupported layouts/calling conventions; device/MMIO/IRQ/DMA profiles separately qualified on actual hardware.
- [ ] **P3 C/C++ translation.** `c2hepta` real compilation database + source oracle, safe/guarded/bridged/unsupported manifest; C++ L0–L3 RAII/templates/callbacks/exception ABI scopes; complete third-party multi-file build/upstream version upgrade, real differential failures and independently measured human migration/maintenance time.
- [ ] **P4 global optimization.** Registered finite candidate space and objective, sound Core/LLVM transformation checks with failure/exception/resource traces, robust optimization/e-graph/DP controls and native x86/ARM benchmarks; strictly fair Rust/C/C++ optimized baselines, CPU/RSS/p95/p99/energy and strong workload heldout; no generic global-optimum claim.
- [ ] **P5 native Rust NDU advantage.** Advisory original evaluator only (no safety bypass), equal complete candidate bank/budget/observation across fixed/DP/NDU, independently attested real build/verification/search/failure/switch/controller/human/rollback costs; paired task-level holdout with multiple seeds/targets and source-disjoint natural workloads; measurable reproducible *positive full lifecycle* advantage. Existing negative results retained.
- [ ] **P6 Agent Coding productivity.** Frozen unseen maintenance/upgrade tasks from real projects, equal model and tool budgets, full prompt/token/cost and native artifact receipts, hidden scoring after public validation, fair representation/2×2 controls and human review burden; significant correctness and *total-cost* advantage; known provider quota failures not relabeled as model failure or success.
- [ ] **P7 production runtime/recovery.** Production Final-use gate, generation fences and immutable bytes/signed authority identity, owned state snapshot/queue journal, internal cancel/partial native progress, crash/power-loss replay/restart and rollback with no duplicate external effects, true on-host resource/latency/recovery tests, long-lived fault injection and target deployment. Small live-process owner experiments are not durable exactly-once semantics.

## Invariants for future changes

1. Check exact commit + prospective merge tree on **the intended target**, not only the old green PR head. Record toolchain, host, executable hashes, test selectors and observable failure paths.
2. Keep `authority=DENY_ALL`, `safety_certificate=false` and `production_activation_allowed=false` until a *separate* independent release authority validates all applicable requirements.
3. Every unknown/unsupported/failed measurement is `OPEN`, not `0`, not `pass`. Retain negative NDU/Rust/C++/Agent studies verbatim.
4. Avoid merging stacked research PRs wholesale: compare exact base/head, preserve both parents and overlapping semantic roles; run source-exact independent CI after convergence.
5. Close this issue only after all eight checkboxes are independently verified and the exact final production source is ready. Do not claim completion from a documentation edit or synthetic evidence.
